permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Voice to Groq, questions to Google Gemini, weather and air quality from Open-Meteo, rates from open.er-api.com, maps from Esri/OpenStreetMap, places from Photon and Nominatim, walking routes from OSRM (FOSSGIS), facts from Wikipedia and DuckDuckGo, headlines from Wikipedia and Hacker News, and relayed notifications from ntfy.sh.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records from the glasses microphones while you talk to EDITH, and for live captions and meeting notes.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Shows where you are on the map, gives walking directions, finds nearby places for radar and place reminders, and gives local weather.
